answer_1.quote: Among natural language processing (NLP) tasks, the automatic generation of a long-form story is a representative task that requires creativity and long-term planning skills.

answer_2.quote: We apply auto evaluation metrics including n-gram entropy (Ent-2) to evaluate the degree of content repetition ... and our proposed conflict rate (CR.) to evaluate the contextual consistency of the generated stories.

answer_3.quote: Since LLM-as-a-judge has been verified by experiments and it can evaluate some features of a text within a certain length according to rules, we apply LLM to further detect the conflict quadruples based on time order.
models: LLM used in Temporal Conflict Analyzer (e.g., Qwen1.5-72B-Chat)
methods: Temporal Conflict Analyzer using LLM judgment

answer_4.quote: We recruited three well-educated graduate students as evaluators and asked them to rank stories according to plot completeness, coherence, relevance, interest level, and expression coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rank generated stories based on specified criteria such as plot completeness, plot coherence, relevance, interestingness, and expression coherence.
